incident.location_detail: Main stage
incident.summary: During a live demo block on the main stage, a guest reported seeing 'a wolf on the stage' while Team 12, wearing wolf-ear headbands, howled on cue into a wireless mic feeding back at 4.1 kHz / 94 dB. The howl was traced to mic 3 in the monitor wedge and the gain was cut at 19:34. One attendee ducked under a chair. Crowd motion (1,420 events in 10 min) and 27C room heat are consistent with a standing, cheering audience; EMF 3 mG is low. No physical animal was confirmed by the stage tech, and the report does not establish whether the sighting was a misperception of the costumed performers, a projection, or something else. Demo 13 is up next.
